elements.el: ended=idle: 60 minutes idle (an open live tab does not count)
elements.reason: the limits are the console's own (PI_CONSOLE_IDLE_MINUTES), written in when the page is drawn

elements.el: ended=max: the 12-hour maximum
elements.reason: the limit is the console's own (PI_CONSOLE_MAX_HOURS)

elements.el: ended=revoked: a revoked or rotated token
ended=role: a changed role
ended=all: an operator ended every session
ended=elsewhere: signing out in another tab
ended=restart: a console restart
elements.reason: worded as a possibility: the server reaches it only for an id it does not know while it has been up less than a session's longest life, never as a claim

elements.el: ended=device: this browser was removed from the remembered devices
ended=device-store: the remembered sign-in could not be checked
No code yet: the help leads with pi-dispatch-console link, which prints a code to type and a link
elements.reason: issue #882, review: the first command used to be ./pi-dispatch console, which prints no code; the disclosure for another browser went with it, since the command it held now leads

elements.el: Remember this trusted device: a box under the token field, ticked to start with, drawn only where the console would remember the browser
ended=device-kept: signed out, but the remembered sign-in could not be erased
401: a wrong token
401: a code that did not work
elements.reason: issue #882: the 401 of /login/typed-code, the route the code's form posts to (NOTICE_OF_STATUS), so a refused code is never read as a wrong token

elements.el: 401: a used or expired link
elements.reason: said by the link page's used state (the AccessStates card's p-link-used), whole, with the commands for a new link; /login never answers a link (its 401 is the wrong token), so no notice repeats it (the sign-in page's link notice was drawn and never shown, and is gone)

elements.el: 429: too many attempts (5 a minute)
503: a tokens file the console cannot use
elements.reason: the 503 body is the server's own TOKENS_UNUSABLE; the page says it in its notice

elements.el: 500: an audit log it cannot write
Which refusal each status selects
"Console not reachable, retrying" keeps the page
elements.reason: for 30 tries or 60 s at most (script.mjs SIGN_IN_TRIES_MAX, SIGN_IN_RETRY_FOR_MS); then the token is dropped and the script's own gaveup notice (SIGN_IN_GAVE_UP, a copy of this one) asks for Sign in again

elements.el: The footer says the console answers at pi-dispatch.localhost, on this host only
elements.reason: worded by where the console listens: pi-dispatch.localhost for 127.0.0.1 and ::1 (issue #882: a name of the console's own, so its cookies reach no other local web server), another loopback address, its unix socket, or nothing about loopback for a public bind

elements.el: The code K7QX-9M2D in the field

elements.el: The token placeholder (the token prefix and an ellipsis)
elements.reason: the leak canary fails any body holding the token prefix, so the field has no placeholder

elements.el: The 5-second retry interval
elements.reason: the script retries every 2 s (script.mjs RETRY_MS, the stream's own retry), and the notice says 2 seconds

elements.el: The "What this page says" column
elements.reason: a design-only listing of the notices; the page shows one at a time, and each is its own panel golden
